finding: Host planning UI check uses getByText(projectName).first().waitFor visible; first occurrence belongs to a correctly hidden inactive panel, although the active summary may render the same text visibly.
nativeCorrectiveTask: Portare la vista attiva prima dei pannelli nascosti
interpretation: A brittle selector constrains DOM order. Moving the active panel first can satisfy the fixed check without changing domain behavior. This is not evidence of a functional user-visible defect and must be distinguished from the preceding saved-dialog-close failure.
